Home workout app
I've done Tai Chi since I was about 3 years old. That's what my parents said, anyway. I imagine I wasn't that great at it.
While my Tai Chi practice has been off and on through the years, I have been exposed to a lot of it. I'm still hesitant to comment on it, because I don't feel like I know the current discussions on it. Like is there are hot debate about the "grasp the sparrow's tail move?" Maybe. Who knows. Maybe the debate is only in Mandarin too.
